PluginData.Tooltip: 1.0.7 — Docked refill: compatible weapons, native fuel, gas tanks and cargo unloading.
PluginData.Description: Tactical HUD, Spectrum-aligned signals, shared contacts, hidden distress GPS and combat telemetry. Dedicated REFILL tab: click-to-bind shortcut, compatible weapon loading, native SDX2 fusion pellets, oxygen/fuel gas tank refill, optional cargo unloading, and reinforced cargo priority for ammunition reserves. Includes responsive HUD resizing and automatic overlay shutdown. Windows / Pulsar Legacy.
